notes.title: Gamepad support!
notes.content: Added support for the Xbox 360 gamepad, DualShock 4 also works well, but the Xbox ONE gamepad may not work correctly.

notes.title: Plastic bag and ball gag
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/0e1663650efa5f1d017da2fe81689a418db99992.jpg https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/ef76de0080be866ef970e6a49c88edeb3c4319f2.jpg https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34882436/4ece5f25ac84fcf1ce70bf08953f6d2ece2cc07f.jpg

 Implemented a crazy idea that I really liked. Now, if you wish, the
main heroine may have a plastic bag on his head and you need to get to the phone before the heroine suffocates.
 Added a ball gag.
 Stronger heroine. Moving around is now a little easier.
 Added first-person view. It's almost impossible to play, but it was interesting for me to do it :)
